## Prerequisites

- A trial/developer Microsoft 365 tenant with Entra ID P2 (PIM requires P2).
- Microsoft Graph PowerShell:

```powershell
Install-Module Microsoft.Graph -Scope CurrentUser
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory","Directory.Read.All","AuditLog.Read.All"
```

## Step 1 — break-glass account FIRST (Book 10's ordering)

```powershell
$pw = @{ Password = (-join ((65..90)+(97..122)+(48..57) | Get-Random -Count 24 | % {[char]$_})) ; ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $false }
$bg = New-MgUser -DisplayName "EA-BreakGlass-01" -UserPrincipalName "ea-breakglass-01@$((Get-MgDomain | ? IsDefault).Id)" `
       -MailNickname "eabreakglass01" -AccountEnabled -PasswordProfile $pw
# Standing Global Administrator — the ONLY standing one in this lab
$gaRole = Get-MgDirectoryRole -Filter "displayName eq 'Global Administrator'"
New-MgDirectoryRoleMemberByRef -DirectoryRoleId $gaRole.Id -OdataId "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$($bg.Id)"
```

Record the password offline (in production: FIDO2 keys + physical safe).
Exclude this account from every Conditional Access policy you create below.

## Step 2 — enumerate standing assignments (the "before" evidence)

```powershell
Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleAssignment -ExpandProperty Principal -All |
  Select-Object @{n='Role';e={(Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -UnifiedRoleDefinitionId $_.RoleDefinitionId).DisplayName}},
                @{n='Principal';e={$_.Principal.AdditionalProperties.userPrincipalName}} |
  Export-Csv standing-assignments-before.csv -NoTypeInformation
```

## Step 3 — convert a test admin to PIM eligible-only

Create a test user, grant an **eligible** (not active) Security
Administrator assignment with an 8-hour cap:

```powershell
$u = New-MgUser -DisplayName "Lab Admin" -UserPrincipalName "lab-admin@$((Get-MgDomain | ? IsDefault).Id)" `
      -MailNickname "labadmin" -AccountEnabled -PasswordProfile $pw
$secAdmin = Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -Filter "displayName eq 'Security Administrator'"
New-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleEligibilityScheduleRequest -Action "adminAssign" `
  -PrincipalId $u.Id -RoleDefinitionId $secAdmin.Id -DirectoryScopeId "/" `
  -ScheduleInfo @{ startDateTime = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime(); expiration = @{ type = "afterDuration"; duration = "P90D" } }
```

In the portal (Entra ID → PIM → Roles → Security Administrator → Settings),
set: activation max 8 hours, require MFA, require justification, require
approval. Then, as `lab-admin`, walk the **activation ceremony**: request →
MFA → justification → (approve as yourself) → time-boxed activation →
automatic deactivation.

## Step 4 — report-only Conditional Access (14-day discipline)

Create one policy — "PIM activation requires compliant device" — targeting
directory-role activation, in **report-only** mode, with the break-glass
account excluded. Book 10's rule: 14+ days report-only before enforcement;
in the lab, inspect the report-only results in sign-in logs instead.

## Step 5 — the evidence: PIM audit export

```powershell
Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Filter "loggedByService eq 'PIM'" -All |
  Select-Object ActivityDateTime, ActivityDisplayName,
    @{n='Initiator';e={$_.InitiatedBy.User.UserPrincipalName}},
    @{n='Target';e={$_.TargetResources[0].UserPrincipalName}} |
  ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Out-File pim-audit-trail.json
```

`pim-audit-trail.json` plus `standing-assignments-before.csv` (and an
"after" run showing eligible-only) are the slot-01 artifacts; the device
compliance requirement is the slot-05 angle.

Then the [common final step](index.html#bind-the-evidence):
place the exports where the slot-01/slot-05 mappings can reference them
and regenerate: `<engine> oscal ksi-ar --output exports/oscal/ksi-ar.json`.
Score against the
[slot 1](../assessment-rubrics.html#slot-1) and
[slot 5](../assessment-rubrics.html#slot-5) rubrics.

## Teardown

```powershell
Remove-MgUser -UserId $u.Id
Remove-MgUser -UserId $bg.Id          # lab only — production break-glass is permanent
# Delete the report-only CA policy in the portal, or let the trial tenant expire.
```
